text: 中国酒业协会发布《推动酒类平台经济创新与健康发展》一文。文中称，行业行稳致远离不开法治化、常态化监管。酒类平台诸多乱象，根源在于监管规则与酒水特殊流通属性适配不足。要遵循数字经济与酒类产业规律，革新监管理念，完善全链条监管机制。坚持法治监管，严厉打击线上售假、价格欺诈、数据滥用、算法歧视；聚焦平台流量、定价、抽成、溯源四大核心环节，强化酒类平台反垄断与反不正当竞争，杜绝强制二选一、限流逼价等行为；建立市场监管、酒业协会、平台企业跨部门协同机制，打通产区、线上、线下跨区域联动执法，完善酒水全程溯源标准，保障主播、经销商、消费者合法权益，构建多方共赢格局。
text_en: The China Alcoholic Drinks Association released an article titled 'Promoting Innovation and Healthy Development of Alcohol Platform Economy,' stating that stable industry growth relies on rule-of-law and normalized regulation. Many chaos in alcohol platforms stems from inadequate adaptation of regulatory rules to the special distribution characteristics of alcoholic beverages. It calls for following the laws of digital economy and the alcohol industry, innovating regulatory concepts, and improving chain-wide oversight mechanisms. It emphasizes law-based regulation, cracking down on online counterfeiting, price fraud, data abuse, and algorithmic discrimination; focusing on the four core links of platform traffic, pricing, commission, and traceability; strengthening anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition actions in alcohol platforms, eliminating forced exclusivity and traffic-restricting price coercion; establishing a cross-departmental coordination mechanism among market regulators, industry associations, and platform enterprises; facilitating cross-regional collaborative enforcement across production areas, online, and offline channels; improving full-chain traceability standards for alcoholic beverages; safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of livestreamers, distributors, and consumers, and building a win-win scenario for all parties.
